column2: \n\nNow that we have established a united Platinean nation, it is time to decide a proper capital. A few proposals for it have come forward for suitable cities, now it's only a matter of choosing one.
\n\nWe must decide what type of warship we wish to commission.
\n\nThe warship we commissioned is ready and arrived in one of our naval bases.

\n\nThe USA have sent a grand, white-painted fleet on a world tour as a show of force. They are now arriving in one of our harbors.
\n\nAfter its glorious circumnavigation, the White Fleet has returned to its home port in Hampton Roads, Virginia.
\n\nOur Russian benefactors have agreed to send us generous monetary aid.

\n\nSitting our many joint victories and history of amicable relations, France has proposed we form an alliance, the Entente Cordiale.
\n\nNow that we have captured Islas Malvinas, and with the current sheep farming boom in Patagonia, it is time that we also help expand this boom to the islands.
\n\nSince making a region a colony will rid it of all modifiers, this is an event to restore the patagonia wool boom. It will only happen once, so be careful.
